evidence: Homepage lists 6 templates each showing title, author (e.g. Sarah Chen), and description text.
Each card shows title, author, description, category badge (e.g. Business), scenario badge (e.g. Resume), usage count (e.g. 1,250 uses), and update date (e.g. Updated 2024-12-01).
Clicking 'Use Template' on Professional Resume opens a dialog with template details (title, description, author, uses) and a 'Fill Template' form tab plus disabled 'Preview Result' tab.
Dialog shows warning banner 'Required fields missing' listing all missing required fields by name, and 'Preview Result' tab is disabled while fields are empty.
Preview Result tab is disabled until required fields are filled (verified further after filling all fields, tab became enabled).

All 12 fields of Professional Resume template (Full Name, Job Title, Email, Phone, Summary, Company, Position, Start/End Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Grad Year, Skills) accepted independent text input via fill_form.
After filling required fields, Preview Result tab became enabled and displayed generated resume with entered values substituted (name, title, company, position, dates, degree, school, skills).

actual: Entering 'not-an-email' in the required Email field did not block the Preview tab or show an error; Preview Result tab became enabled and the invalid value 'not-an-email' was inserted verbatim into the generated preview.

issue: No visible success feedback on copy
actual: Clicking 'Copy to Clipboard' multiple times did not change button text, show a toast, or display any 'Copied' message anywhere in the DOM (verified via innerText search).

evidence: With all fields (including optional End Date) filled, preview renders h1 name, bold job title, separator, h2/h3 headings, italic date range 'Jan 2020 - Present', and body paragraphs — all placeholders replaced with entered values.
Professional Resume (Markdown) template renders headings, bold/italic emphasis, and a horizontal separator correctly with substituted field values.

issue: Special Markdown characters in field values are not neutralized
actual: Entering '# Injected Heading\n---\n**Bold Inject**' into the Full Name field was inserted verbatim into the generated preview; the '**Bold Inject**' portion rendered as bold text inside the H1 heading, showing the app does not escape/restrict special characters that alter the generated Markdown structure.

evidence: Clicking the heart icon on Professional Resume and Weekly Status Report cards immediately toggled the button active state and updated the header 'Favorites' badge count from 0 to 1 then to 2.

Clicking heart icons added 2 templates to favorites (badge count updated); clicking 'Favorites' nav button opened a favorites-only view showing 'Showing 2 of 6 templates' with only the favorited cards.

While in favorites-only view, typing 'Weekly' in the search box narrowed results to 'Showing 1 of 6 templates' (Weekly Status Report only); clearing search returned to the full 2-item favorites list, confirming search operates within the favorites-only scope.

Typing 'Re' (2 chars) showed a real-time suggestion dropdown (Professional Resume, Responsibilities, Degree, Weekly Status Report, In Progress); clicking 'Professional Resume' filled the search box and narrowed results to 'Showing 1 of 6 templates'.

actual: Typing 'Resme' (missing the 'u' from 'Resume') returned 'Showing 0 of 6 templates' with a 'No templates found' message and no suggestions, instead of matching 'Professional Resume'.

evidence: Category filter (Weekly Report) narrowed to 1/6; Scenario filter (Academic) narrowed to 1/6; Sort By offers Most Popular, Recently Updated, Oldest First, Alphabetical — selecting Alphabetical reordered cards to: Academic Research Summary, Meeting Minutes, Professional Email, Professional Resume, Project Proposal, Weekly Status Report.

All filter/search/sort/favorites interactions (category, scenario, sort, search, favorites toggle) updated the visible card list and 'Showing X of 6 templates' count instantly without any page reload/navigation.

Submitting with all fields blank showed 'Missing required fields' toast; submitting with title/author/description/content filled but no field defined showed 'No fields defined' toast — both blocked submission until corrected.
After submitting 'QA Test Template' with valid data, a success toast appeared and the library instantly updated to 'Showing 7 of 7 templates' with the new card visible, without any page reload.
Submit Template dialog accepted title, author, description, category, scenario, Markdown content with {{name}} placeholder, and one defined field ('name'), and submitted successfully.

After submission, 'QA Test Template' card appeared in the library; clicking 'Use Template' opened its form with the 'name' field, and filling it produced a working preview 'Timothee / Hello Timothee, welcome!'.
Template defined field 'name' matching content placeholder {{name}} was accepted; generated preview replaced both occurrences of {{name}} with 'Timothee' leaving no unresolved placeholders.

issue: Field/placeholder mapping mismatch is not validated on submission
actual: Submitted a template titled 'Mismatch Test' with a declared field 'unused' (mapped to {{unused}}) while the content only contained the placeholder {{missing}} (with no corresponding field). The submission succeeded ('Template submitted!' toast) and the template was added to the library, instead of being rejected for the unmatched field/placeholder pair.

issue: Duplicate field labels are not rejected or disambiguated
actual: Created a custom template "Dup Field Test" with content "Hello {{dup}}!" and added two separate fields both labeled "dup" (both displayed identically as "dup / text • Optional" mapped to "{{dup}}"). Clicking "Submit Template" succeeded with no warning, error, or automatic renaming (e.g., no "dup (2)" disambiguation). Success toast "Template submitted! Your template has been added to the library." appeared and the new "Dup Field Test" card was added to the library (library count updated to "Showing 9 of 9 templates").
evidence: Submit Template dialog accepted two fields labeled "dup" without validation; post-submit toast and library card confirm acceptance.

After navigating/reloading http://localhost:6089/, Favorites badge still shows "2" (previously favorited Professional Resume and Weekly Status Report), and the library still shows "Showing 9 of 9 templates" including all three previously submitted custom templates ("QA Test Template", "Mismatch Test", "Dup Field Test") alongside the 6 built-in templates. Data persisted across reload.
